about: Cantley is a municipality in the Outaouais, Quebec, on the Gatineau River north of Gatineau—not a city. Riverside countryside, cottage lots, and a growing residential community toward Wakefield define this Ottawa–Gatineau exurb. About 11,000 people live in Cantley.
seoSummary: Outaouais Gatineau River municipality north of Gatineau—riverside countryside and Ottawa–Gatineau exurb, not a city.
